raw_response:
The figure presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of children's news categories. The chart is divided into eight sections, each representing a distinct category.

The categories are labeled as follows: 体育 (Sports) in dark blue, accounting for 21%; 社会 (Society) in orange, making up 20%; 榜样 (榜样) in yellow, constituting 19%; 政治 (Politics) in green, representing 14%; 文化 (Culture) in teal, also 14%; 经济 (Economy) in red, at 6%; 科学 (Science) in dark brown, at 4%; and 环境保护 (Environmental Protection) in brown, making up 2%.

A legend at the bottom of the chart provides a key to the colors used for each category. The chart effectively visualizes the proportion of each category within the children's news.
